subject.title: Support setup codes with separate frontend and API origins

question: Should ClickClack officially support both separate public frontend/API origins and API base-path deployments in the setup-code contract?
rationale: The request adds a deployment topology, configuration field, and cross-repository public API contract; source inspection can establish the limitation but cannot choose the permanent supported topology.

options.title: Support origins and paths
options.body: Add a canonical public API URL, backend-authored claim URL, backward-compatible same-origin default, and coordinated OpenClaw support for exact endpoints.

options.title: Support separate origins only
options.body: Allow a distinct API origin but continue rejecting paths so routing and generated SDK assumptions remain origin-rooted.

options.title: Retain same-origin setup
options.body: Keep reverse-proxy routing under one public origin as the supported topology and document split-origin setup codes as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Support origins and paths
recommendation.body: Add a canonical public API URL, backend-authored claim URL, backward-compatible same-origin default, and coordinated OpenClaw support for exact endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member supplied the proposed contract and its security and compatibility boundaries, making them the strongest available owner for clarifying intended scope.
